select 'SET' k, name, setting||coalesce(' '||unit,'') v, null::text extra from pg_settings
 where name in ('shared_buffers','effective_cache_size','work_mem','maintenance_work_mem','max_connections','autovacuum_work_mem','max_wal_size','wal_buffers','huge_pages','server_version','autovacuum','track_activity_query_size','temp_buffers','max_parallel_workers_per_gather','hash_mem_multiplier')
union all
select 'CONN', coalesce(application_name,'')||' | '||coalesce(usename,''), count(*)::text, string_agg(distinct coalesce(state,'?'),',') from pg_stat_activity where backend_type='client backend' group by 1,2
union all
select 'STATSRESET', 'db', coalesce(stats_reset::text,'never'), (now()-coalesce(stats_reset,now()))::text from pg_stat_database where datname=current_database()
union all
select 'BUFCACHE', 'blks_hit/read', blks_hit::text, blks_read::text from pg_stat_database where datname=current_database()
order by 1,2
